{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the number of such customers
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:", len(new_paid_search))

# Compute the fraction who converted
converted_fraction = new_paid_search['converted'].mean()

print(f"Fraction of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH who converted: {converted_fraction}")"}
